subject: planner, executor: support inline projection for TopN (#58500)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (e79d22f156ca8305de126297d1a85ff900cba586). The change introduces inline projection for TopN by pruning TopN output schema in the planner and projecting required columns at the executor output boundary (plus related schema/index resolution and chunk helpers). Potential Blocker/High candidates in the initial implementation were found to be addressed in later history up to upstream/master, leaving no remaining Blocker/High issues on current master.
